mechanism: Nafcillin may reduce bumetanide efficacy through CYP450 enzyme induction and displacement of protein binding, while loop diuretics increase risk of aminoglycoside-like ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity when combined with beta-lactams.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and diuretic response; assess for ototoxicity symptoms; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if renal function declines.
